provenance.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, precise pose correction.
Input Image1 is the EDIT TARGET: the newly drawn right-facing full-body Lila. Input Image2 is her authoritative original identity reference, used only to preserve the same person, costume, dark limbs and proportions.
Change ONLY the resting leg/foot placement in Image1, plus remove any background haze. Keep the beautiful profile face, one visible eye, warm orange-peach skin, closed smile, hair and tied ponytail, neckline, one-shoulder hide dress, waist belt, ragged single skirt and arms/hands unchanged. No facial redesign or new viewpoint.
The far foot is currently raised above the near foot. Correct her to a grounded neutral SIDE PROFILE stance facing SCREEN RIGHT: both large rounded BLACK feet must lie flat with their BOTTOM SOLES on exactly the same horizontal baseline; two readably separated legs of plausible equal anatomical length, softly relaxed, not bent backward or stretched. Keep both foot tips pointing right. Adjust the farther leg naturally at the hip/knee as needed to reach the shared floor; no pointy V knees, twisted ankle, crossing or third leg. Preserve the source's slim black ink leg thickness and thumbed mitten hands, not round dot extremities.
One complete isolated full character from hair tip to both soles with generous transparent margin. Genuine transparent RGBA background and clean alpha edge; no black/brown glow, solid background, ground shadow, text, props, checkerboard or extra panels. Preserve Image1's painted warm browns, expressive irregular black ink, proportions, contour and opaque-looking interior colors. This is a new sibling correction, not approval of any rig/animation.

reviewNotes: Bản sửa yêu cầu hai sole cùng baseline; chưa có pose/geometry/browser/runtime xác minh. Không khẳng định sửa đúng từng pixel hoặc đã đạt.
Đầu/tóc/trang phục và alpha còn phải đối chiếu source; màu và mũi/mắt/miệng không tự được duyệt từ prompt.
